question: Which technique achieved the highest val_accuracy in the regularization experiments dataset, and what drawbacks of early stopping does the overfitting mitigation guide list?
answer: The technique that achieved the highest val_accuracy in the regularization experiments dataset was L2 regularization combined with early stopping [D1]. Early stopping has drawbacks including requiring a held-out validation set that is not used for training, results are sensitive to the patience value, and noisy validation curves can trigger a premature stop [S1] [S2].

citations.text:
L2 regularization and early stopping
3. Early stopping Early stopping monitors validation loss during training and stops when it has not
improved for a fixed number of epochs (the patience); the best checkpoint is restored. Advantages:
it needs no change to the model, saves training compute, and the stopping epoch acts as an
implicit regularizer. Disadvantages: it requires a held-out validation set that is then not used for
training, results are sensitive to the patience value, and noisy validation curves can trigger a
premature stop. 4. Dropout Dropout randomly zeroes a fraction p of hidden units at each training
step so units cannot co-adapt. It is applied only during training. It is mainly used for neural
networks.

Dropout and choosing between methods
5. Choosing between methods L2 and early stopping are complementary and are often combined.
Early stopping is cheapest; L2 gives a smoother, more reproducible solution. Compare methods by
validation accuracy, never by training accuracy.

S5.text: is bias squared plus variance plus irreducible noise. Increasing model complexity lowers bias but raises variance.  Ways to reduce overfitting include collecting more training data, simplifying the model, regularization (L1 and L2 penalties that shrink weights; L1 can drive weights to exactly zero), early stopping, dropout for neural networks, feature selection and cross-validation to choose hyperparameters. Learning curves, which plot error against training set size, help diagnose whether a model suffers from high bias or high variance.
